name: Astrid Olsen
bio:
Astrid's path to motorsport finance wasn't exactly traditional. After earning her degree in economics from the University of Oslo, she spent several years in the corporate world, but felt something was missing. A lifelong motorsports enthusiast, she volunteered at local rally events, managing budgets and sponsorships. This ignited a passion for combining her financial acumen with her love for racing.

At RSC Motorsport, Astrid is known for her meticulous approach and innovative problem-solving. She believes in transparent financial practices and is always looking for ways to maximize budget efficiency without compromising performance. Her data-driven insights and ability to identify hidden financial opportunities have made her an invaluable asset to the team. Astrid also champions sustainable finance initiatives within the team, ensuring the future of RSC Motorsport.

What makes Astrid stand out is her ability to bridge the gap between the technical and financial sides of the sport. She understands the impact of every upgrade and adjustment on the overall budget, making her a key player in strategic decision-making.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back into a practical ponytail during race weekends.
physical.description: Astrid has a focused and intelligent look, often accentuated by her stylish, rectangular glasses.

quirks: Always has a spreadsheet open, even during lunch.
Insists on color-coding all financial documents.
Brings a thermos of homemade herbal tea to every race event.
